summary.description:
Today, a bit warmer for the feels like temperature (up 4.2°C) and outside temperature (up 3.6°C) and more moisture-laden outside humidity (up 9%) and rainfall (up 3.6 mm).

Compared to today, yesterday also had noticeable differences in cloud levels (up 585 m) and pressure (up 19 mbar).

The past week and month had observable variation in cloud levels (up 614 m), inside temperature (up 2.8°C), dew point temperature (down 1.7°C), and rainfall (down 3.3 mm) when compared to today.
